title: Mochizuki Honami — Cool Rider Lady〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I think that's about it in terms of our schedule leading up to our next show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's start chipping away at our ticket quota tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have to sell tickets every time now, right? It isn't going to be that easy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is something you have to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because this is a part of what it means to be in a band.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. This is one of those obstacles we'll have to keep clearing if we really do want to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (To think that she actually tried to do this all on her own before...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're still working on our new song, right? Based on what I saw today, it's going to take a few more days to hammer everything out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if we have to start selling tickets to play in shows, we won't have enough time to create, practice and finish any new songs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So for now, I want all of you to keep working on our new song. You can leave selling tickets to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But this is something we have to do as a band now...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The four of you will be fine as long as you're together! Right, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's do the best we can, together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Or in this case, divide and conquer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: Okay!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika and the other said that they'll be inviting their classmates to come see us perform. Maybe I should as well.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'll start with...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: No, no, it's understandable. We were worried about you, you know? You seemed so sad lately.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah! But you didn't look like you wanted to talk, so we didn't know what to do about it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Thank you for opening up. And...sorry I said those mean things about Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No worries!
Shiho is actually very nice. I could introduce you to her, if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Sure, I'd like to get to know her! By the way, do you guys have any gigs planned yet?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, we only just started...
But once we do, you're invited!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Cool! I'm already hyped to see you on stage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can finally fulfill my promise to them.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(But that was such a long time ago...
I hope they still remember...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(No, that doesn't matter.
It's my duty to go ask them, and I want them to come see us play.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's go!
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good morning, you two.
There's something I'd like to ask the both of you. Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, you seem kinda concerned.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, my band's going to be playing in a show soon, and I was wondering if you'd like to come see us...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wait, you guys are doing a show...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. You'll have to purchase tickets to see us perform, but would that be alright...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Honami...
You kept your promise!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh?! Wh-What's going on?
Why are you hugging me?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Because that was forever ago, and we're really happy that you remembered!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Anyway, when are you guys playing?
Also, how much are the tickets? I just got my paycheck from work, so money's no object for me right now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: How many songs do you get to play? I'll make sure to try listening to them beforehand!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, one at a time.
After school

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami...
I'm about to head off to practice. Wanna go together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho!
I'll be right there! I just need another minute to pack!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Anyway, let's head to club.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami told us all about your upcoming show, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We've been wondering what kind of music your guys' band plays.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: So we're really looking forward to seeing you on stage!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise to give you a good performance.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Anyway, Honami, see you later!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You asked them to come see us...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I'll need to keep polishing my drumming to give them a good show.
